summary: Sempra filed an 8-K to report the closing of a $1 billion floating-rate note offering due 2028, a routine debt capital markets transaction under its existing shelf registration statement. The notes pay Compounded SOFR plus 0.670%, mature January 7, 2028, and are not redeemable early. Proceeds net of underwriting discount were ~$998.5 million. Underwriters included BMO Capital Markets and Academy Securities. This is a standard financing event, not a special situation.
